terbaru.judul: Analysis of a Spatialized Brain-Body-Environment System
terbaru.pelajaran: To address this limitation, we propose a spatially extended approach using partial differential equations (PDEs) for both the brain and body.

terbaru.judul: Guiding Evolution of Artificial Life Using Vision-Language Models
terbaru.pelajaran: We test our method empirically in the Lenia substrate using Gemma-3 to propose evolutionary targets, and show that EST promotes greater visual novelty, while ETT fosters more coherent and interpretable evolutionary sequences.

terbaru.judul: Shachi: A Modular, Controllable Framework for LLM-Based Agent-Based Modeling of Emergent Collective Behavior
terbaru.pelajaran: To address this, we introduce Shachi, a principled methodology and modular framework that decomposes an agent's cognition into core components: Configuration for intrinsic identity, Memory for contextual continuity, and Tools for extended capabilities, all orchestrated by an LLM reasoning engine.

terbaru.judul: Equilibrium flow: From Snapshots to Dynamics
terbaru.pelajaran: We introduce the Equilibrium flow method, a framework that learns continuous dynamics that preserve a given pattern distribution.

terbaru.judul: ZapGPT: Free-form Language Prompting for Simulated Cellular Control
terbaru.pelajaran: We show that the evolved system generalizes to unseen prompts without retraining.

terbaru.judul: Data-Driven Discovery of Emergent Dynamics in Reaction-Diffusion Systems from Sparse and Noisy Observations
terbaru.pelajaran: In this paper, we present findings on the applicability of a conceptual framework, the Data-driven Rulesets for Soft Artificial Life (DRSALife) model, to learn Soft ALife rulesets that accurately represent emergent dynamics in a reaction-diffusion system from observed data.

terbaru.judul: Expedition & Expansion: Leveraging Semantic Representations for Goal-Directed Exploration in Continuous Cellular Automata
terbaru.pelajaran: We introduce Expedition and Expansion (E&E), a hybrid strategy where exploration alternates between local novelty-driven expansions and goal-directed expeditions.

terbaru.judul: Plantbot: Integrating Plant and Robot through LLM Modular Agent Networks
terbaru.pelajaran: We introduce Plantbot, a hybrid lifeform that connects a living plant with a mobile robot through a network of large language model (LLM) modules.

terbaru.judul: Composable Life: Speculation for Decentralized AI Life
terbaru.pelajaran: "Composable Life" is a hybrid project blending design fiction, experiential virtual reality, and scientific research.

terbaru.judul: Evolutionary Brain-Body Co-Optimization Consistently Fails to Select for Morphological Potential
terbaru.pelajaran: We show that this design space constitutes a good model for studying brain-body co-optimization and that our mapping roughly captures its landscape.
